handoff.salientSummary: Round-2 user testing of foh-core: 10 of the 12 re-tested assertions now pass (VAL-FND-006, VAL-FND-009, VAL-SETUP-020/021/023/025, VAL-BOOK-008/009/013, VAL-HOST-014); 2 still fail (VAL-BOOK-003: the API returns the occasion tag id instead of the chosen value; VAL-BOOK-037: the contact-status chip renders English 'Left message' in Arabic). All re-checked regression paths pass. Round-1 synthesis preserved; validation-state.json and synthesis.json (round 2) updated.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Ran the foh-core round-2 user-testing validation on branch pr/reservations with the pre-existing tenant-api US (3007) and KSA (3009) nodes plus a freshly started App dev server (3001); Sites/Admin were not needed. Seven flow-validator groups in three batches: r2-flaggate (module gate off/on via the D1 recipe), r2-engine (engine + property/scale suites), r2-api (curl verification of the setup/book/host APIs), r2-setup-ui and r2-book-ui (browser), r2-today-rtl (Arabic RTL + Today), r2-floor (floor drag seating), r2-suites (targeted Vitest suites + static checks). Results were synthesized into validation-state.json (10 assertions moved to passed, 2 kept failed with narrowed root causes) and validation/foh-core/user-testing/synthesis.json round 2; library/user-testing.md gained the round-2 environment contract, isolation registry, flow-validator guidance and the results/findings block. No product code was modified and the repository working tree is unchanged.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: VAL-BOOK-003 and VAL-BOOK-037 still fail and need an orchestrator decision (fix or amend the clause). VAL-SETUP-026's browser half was not re-exercised end to end (its location is in sync; forcing a mismatch would have written outside the group's isolation boundary) - its round-1 pass is kept, with the terminal half green and the banner observed rendering on the second acme location. VAL-CROSS-006 was deliberately not touched (moved to online-booking-sites-and-app-ui). The residual engine observation (a hold passed through the generic `occupancies` input still ignores expiresAt) is recorded as a non-blocking suggestion, not a failure of VAL-FND-006.

commandsRun.observation: Both nodes answered {"status":"ok",...} for regions us and ksa; probe of the new location-scoped DELETE alias answered 401 without a token (not 404) and an unknown route answered 404, proving the running US node serves the post-fix code (the day feed returned `counters` and `moveNotices` keys).

tests.coverage: No tests were written by this validator (validators do not modify product code). Coverage was provided by running the repositories' own suites through the r2-engine and r2-suites groups: the @repo/reservations engine and property/scale suites (26 and 73 tests), tenant-api reservations routes/security/write/booking-service suites (51 tests), tenant-db reservation schema tests (6), App reservations utility suites incl. the guards test (66 tests) and the engine unit tests (15) - all passing, which is the regression evidence for the two fix commits.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-BOOK-003: GET /operator/reservations/book/reservations/:id returns occasion='tag_acme_anniversary' (identical to occasionTagId) instead of the chosen value 'anniversary'. The booking sheet's OCCASION_OPTIONS submit bare values and the new OCCASION_LABELS map is keyed by bare values, so the App hides the mismatch by stripping the 'tag_acme_' prefix (book-api.ts:888-891). All other clauses of the assertion pass.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: In the reservation serializer/day-feed mapping, return the bare occasion value in `occasion` (derivable by stripping the tag prefix or by storing the submitted value) and keep the tag id only in `occasionTagId`; or amend the assertion to accept the resolved tag id.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-BOOK-037: the contact-status chip renders the English humanized enum 'Left message' in the Arabic UI (row rsv_acme_1, contact_status='left_message'), because CONTACT_STATUS_LABELS (apps/app/app/utils/reservations/labels.ts:34-39) and CONTACT_STATUSES (apps/app/app/components/reservations/detail-sheet.tsx:61-66) use the invented keys sms_sent|left_voicemail|confirmed_by_phone while the canonical vocabulary is left_message|no_answer|wrong_number (architecture.md:716). The detail sheet's Contact Tracking selector therefore cannot display or set the stored value.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Rekey both maps to the canonical values (left_message|no_answer|wrong_number), add the Arabic msgstr entries, and re-run lingui:extract plus check-lingui.mjs.

discoveredIssues.description: Residual engine observation (not a VAL-FND-006 failure): a hold row passed through the generic `occupancies` input still ignores expiresAt, because availability.ts:415-430 maps input.occupancies straight into assignBookings. Only the two adjudicated paths (existingHolds and the kind === 'hold' branch) carry the expiry filter.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Either document that holds must be passed via existingHolds/holds, or apply the same expiresAt filter when mapping occupancies rows whose kind is 'hold'.

discoveredIssues.description: GET /operator/reservations/setup/locations/:id/conflicts runs the reflow engine, so a read can append reservation events and bump rsv_day_versions; rsv_day_versions also does not increase by exactly 1 per block create/delete.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Decide whether the conflicts read should be side-effect free; otherwise note the behaviour in the docs.

discoveredIssues.description: The business date used by some operator book routes falls back to the UTC date (operator-reservations-book.ts:199,278,377), so Today showed 2026-10-17 while the org time zone was still on 2026-10-16 at 23:15 EDT. Pre-existing, not caused by this round's fixes.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Derive the default business date from the location time zone in those handlers.
